about.name: NURUL AKBAR
about.bio:
As an Information Systems graduate and Software Engineer, I specialize in translating complex business needs into efficient web applications.

From digitizing operational workflows to architecting frontend interfaces, I thrive on building scalable full-stack solutions from the ground up that deliver real-world impact.

description: Architecting and developing an interactive university web platform using Laravel for academic publications.
Integrating an LMS (Learning Management System) to empower seamless online learning and course management.
Conducting scheduled maintenance, web content administration, and overall system optimization.
Providing remote IT support to academic staff and lecturers regarding software and web platform operations.
Developed a web-based tourism information system using CodeIgniter 4, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript.
Engineered online booking and equipment rental features to streamline the visitor reservation process.
Implemented digital promotion features to enhance destination visibility and outreach.
Built a centralized admin dashboard for data management and real-time transaction reporting.
Conducted component loading and CheckPart inspections to ensure parts met strict engineering specifications.
Executed CheckMan procedures meticulously throughout the manufacturing line workflow.
Performed thorough quality control to guarantee finished parts were free of scratches or defects (NG - Not Good).
Operated air blow equipment for part cleaning and maintained workplace 5S cleanliness standards.
